profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Incident IQ
profile.summary: I completed my B.S. in Mechanical Engineering in 2017 and completed my M.S. in Computer Science in 2021, both degrees from Georgia Tech. I love to learn and am always looking for opportunities to grow my skills as an engineer and programmer!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Develop new features for electronic payments software, using C++. 
- Develop an automation framework and write automated test cases in Python and C#. 
- Take an active role in code design and architecture, ensuring the development of clean, scalable, and maintainable solutions
- Demonstrate strong attention to detail and documentation skills by creating comprehensive technical documentation, aiding in knowledge transfer, and ensuring effective code maintenance
- Conduct code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers to promote code quality, adherence to best practices, and overall improvement in the development process.
- Mentored and led a team of six interns on a project that leveraged GCP (Google Cloud Platform), React, and PostGresSQL among other technologies.
- Mentored multiple full-time software engineer new hires
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C++ · C# · Mentoring · Project Management

positions.title: Instructional Associate
positions.description:
- Successfully manage a course in artificial intelligence comprising hundreds of students per semester, ensuring smooth operations and delivering an optimal learning experience.
- Facilitate discussions, moderate threads, and address student inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
- Act as a reliable point of contact for students, actively engaging with their feedback, and incorporating suggestions for course improvement.
- Responsibly grade papers, providing constructive feedback to students to foster academic growth and improvement.
- Taught in Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Teaching · University Teaching

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed building automation systems
- Selected hardware 
- Wrote sequences of operation
- Created system and wiring diagrams
- Coordinated with project managers and field technicians

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored Georgia Tech students in Calculus, Physics, Differential Equations, Statics, and Programming
